subject: Downstream subcontracting changes — Order Form clause alignment & DPA evidence
messages:
From: Stacey Allen <stacey@acmecloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed subcontractor addition — Order Form redline

Karthik,

We had legal loop back after the pricing review and they flagged a downstream subcontractor we plan to add (VendorWorks) that requires flow-down on security and DPA terms. Attached is the latest Order Form (ACME_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf) with our in-line notes (page 3 clause 5.2 and appendix B).

Key asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept a Subprocessor flow-down that includes the same DPA annex we use for direct processors?
- If not, what specific clause language would you propose as an alternative?
- We need a timeline for evidence (SOC2 report or equivalent) and the subprocessor matrix for procurement.

We'd like to lock this before the procurement meeting next Thursday (3/23). Tara from VendorWorks is copied here for any runbook details.

Thanks,
Stacey
Stacey Allen
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Acme Cloud
stacey@acmecloud.com
Attachment: ACME_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf (pdf, 320KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stacey Allen <stacey@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed subcontractor addition — Order Form redline

Hi Stacey — thanks for the note and the redlines. Looping in Kimberly and Laura from Legal/Procurement to confirm the acceptance path. A few quick items from infra/contracting perspective: 

1) We can accept a flow-down that references our DPA annex by consent, but we generally require either:
   - a direct execution of a DPA annex between Acme and VendorWorks with Redwood as named processor; or
   - Redwood-signed order form + VendorWorks-submitted subprocessor evidence (SOC2 Type II attestation, plus an entry in the subprocessor matrix).

2) For the Order Form changes you marked (clause 5.2), can you confirm whether that language is a hard requirement or a preference? If it's mandatory for ACME procurement, we can propose replacement wording that preserves the security obligations but limits unilateral cascading liability.

3) Timeline: if we get VendorWorks' SOC2 report and the filled subprocessor_matrix.xlsx by COB Wednesday (3/21), Legal can prepare a tracked-change DPA annex and we can aim to get execution via DocuSign before your meeting on 3/23.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether we need an MSA amendment + annex or if an order-form annex is sufficient here? Laura — FYI in case procurement needs an approval ticket.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: subprocessor_matrix.xlsx (stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stacey Allen <stacey@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed subcontractor addition — Order Form redline

Thanks all — quick legal take and proposed path: 

- We prefer VendorWorks execute a short DPA annex that mirrors Redwood's standard annex. If VendorWorks refuses, we can accept their execution provided Acme confirms flow-down obligations in the Order Form and provides evidence bucket items below.

Required evidence (if no vendor annex):
- Current SOC2 Type II (latest 12-month period) or ISO27001 cert.
- Completed subprocessor_matrix.xlsx with data residency, access scope, and contact for security incidents.
- Signed statement of no further sub-delegation beyond named entities, OR an explicit list if present.

Contract language proposal: replace the current ACME insertion at 5.2 with: 
"VendorWorks shall process Customer Data only in accordance with (i) the instructions set forth in this Order Form and (ii) the Security & Data Processing Addendum incorporated by reference. VendorWorks shall ensure comparable contractual commitments from any subprocessor and remain liable for subprocessor acts and omissions."

This preserves acme's ask for flow-down while keeping Redwood's liability footprint explicit. If that looks acceptable to Acme, we'll prepare tracked changes and a short cover memo for your procurement committee.

Attachment: subprocessor_matrix.xlsx (filled template — please review vendor fields)

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procure@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Stacey Allen <stacey@acmecloud.com>, Tara Singh <tara@vendorworks.co>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed subcontractor addition — Order Form clause alignment & DPA evidence

Kim/Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Acme procurement is comfortable with Kimberly's replacement wording; the committee prioritizes a clear evidence trail. Next steps on our side: 

- VendorWorks to upload SOC2 report to the secure evidence locker and complete the subprocessor_matrix.xlsx by EOD 3/21.
- Redwood to provide a tracked-change Order Form (with Kim's language) and a short cover memo for the procurement packet.
- We will circulate an approval PDF to signatories and manage DocuSign routing. DocuSign (embedded) link: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abc123

If Redwood can get the tracked document to us by tomorrow morning we should be able to keep the 3/23 meeting timeline.

Procurement Team
Horizon Analytics (on behalf of Acme Cloud)
